items.title: Describe a person who taught you something useful
items.prompt: Describe a person who taught you something useful
bullets: and explain why it was useful
part3: What qualities make a good teacher?
Do people learn more from family or from school?
Is it better to learn practical skills from a person or from online videos?
Should older people keep learning new skills?
How has the role of teachers changed in recent years?
sampleNotes: My grandfather — retired electrician, patient and calm
Taught me to fix basic wiring and change a fuse at 14
Useful: saved money, gave me confidence to try repairs myself

items.title: Describe a quiet place you like to visit
items.prompt: Describe a quiet place you like to visit
bullets: and explain why you like it
part3: Why do people need quiet places in cities?
Is noise pollution getting worse in your country?
Should there be more rules about noise in public places?
Do young people enjoy silence as much as older people?
sampleNotes: Rooftop garden of the city library, 10 minutes from home
Go most Saturday mornings — read, plan my week
Contrast with traffic noise; helps me think clearly
